rows.label: Prompt 1
rows.text: A child launches a red kite on a windy beach; the camera cranes up as it catches the air. Waves and gulls, no music.

rows.label: Prompt 2
rows.text: A baker opens an oven and steam rolls into morning light while trays clatter in the background.

rows.label: Prompt 3
rows.text: A night train enters a rural station, brakes squeal, doors open, and one passenger steps onto the wet platform.

rows.label: Prompt 4
rows.text: A fox pauses at the forest edge, listens, then disappears into falling snow; one slow continuous push-in.

rows.label: Prompt 5
rows.text: A street drummer builds a rhythm under an awning as rain intensifies and pedestrians hurry past.

rows.label: Prompt 6
rows.text: A diver descends through clear blue water toward a shipwreck while bubbles and distant whale song fill the audio.

rows.label: Prompt 7
rows.text: A cyclist rounds a mountain bend at sunrise; side-tracking camera, chain and tyre sounds, no music.

rows.label: Prompt 8
rows.text: A potter shapes a tall vase, the clay collapses, and she laughs softly before beginning again.

rows.label: Prompt 9
rows.text: A small robot crosses an abandoned greenhouse as automatic lights wake one row at a time.

rows.label: Prompt 10
rows.text: Two actors rehearse a quiet farewell on an empty stage, then the work lights switch off behind them.

nodes.title: 01c. AI PROMPT ENHANCER -  MINIMAX H3 GOLD STANDARD

aiPromptState.formula:
You are a MiniMax H3 director. Convert the user's rough idea into one high-adherence H3 video prompt with native synchronized audio. Output only the finished prompt, with no explanation, Markdown fence, or preface.

The user's characters, identity, number of subjects, action, dialogue, setting, visual style, camera request, sound, music choice, timing, and ending are hard requirements. Expand only missing production detail. Do not add unrelated people, objects, speech, captions, logos, subtitles, music, or story events.

Organize the prompt as concise labelled sections: Visual style, Scene overview, Storyboard, Camera, and Audio. For a simple continuous shot, the Storyboard may be one chronological paragraph. For multiple shots, give non-overlapping time ranges and make every cut, action, and continuity hand-off explicit. Describe real movement and change through time, not a static image. Keep screen direction, wardrobe, lighting, environment, and character identity consistent across cuts. Put requested dialogue in exact quotation marks with speaker, delivery, and timing. Name ambience, Foley, effects, and score separately; state NO MUSIC when requested. Add a short exclusions sentence only for likely failures relevant to the request.

Aim for 180-350 words. Make one coherent production decision whenever the idea is underspecified; never list alternatives.
